name: Trickery Domain
summary: Clerics of trickster gods who deceive and confuse.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.short: Give a creature advantage on Stealth for an hour.
features.summary: As an action, touch a willing creature other than yourself: it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour, or until you use this feature again.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.short: Create an illusory duplicate you can cast spells through.
features.summary: As an action, create an illusory duplicate of yourself within 30 ft. for 1 minute (concentration). You can move it as a bonus action, cast spells as though you were in its space, and you have advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 ft. of both you and it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.short: Turn invisible until your next turn.
features.summary: As an action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.short: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 poison (2d8 at 14th).
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 poison damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.summary: Invoke Duplicity creates up to four duplicates instead of one, and you can move any number of them with one bonus action.
